subject: [hw] T01 -> V17: k18_float fails all arm-O2/thumb-O2 seeds (scalar VMLA/VCVT path); k_fminmax armv8 19/20
body:
The V18 float kernel exposes a VFP mismatch. Current run_diff (130 kernels):

  k18_float arm-O2 seed0 expected 7acc60df got bb822801; all 20 seeds; thumb-O2 all 20; arm-O3v/armv8 pass (different code shape)
  k_fminmax armv8-O3v seed1 expected 9d74bfde got 0d9cbfde; 19/20 seeds
  k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v all 20 (expected seed0 11db464b got 949aa8bf)

gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels/k14_v18_neon.c:k18_float is `o = a*b + (a-b)` on floats; at arm-O2 the disassembly is scalar VFP: vmov.f32 s0,#0.25, s2,#0.5; vcvt.f32.u32 s4/s6/s8 from core regs; vmul.f32 s4,s4,s2; vmla.f32 s8,s6,s0; vsub.f32 s6,s8,s4; vmla.f32 s6,s8,s4; vstmia. My isolated vmla.f32 (4+2*3), vcvt.f32.u32 (65535 and 0x80008000) and vmov s-register tests all match. So the difference is likely one of: VMLA.F32 rounding/fusion semantics, VCVT.f32.u32 for a value/rounding case, or vmov.f32 immediate (#-1.0) / s-register transfer. Please run k18_float under your unit harness or ask me for a per-iteration dump; the kernel is now in tests/emu/kernels/k14_v18_neon.c (V18s original). k_fminmax is mine (tests/emu/kernels/k04_float.c); it uses comparisons/negation and only fails in the armv8 config, so likely a VMAXNM/VMINNM or VSEL path there. No phone, as usual.
